agents.finish_summary: Fixed the failing end-to-end charge test. Root cause: the "externalize secrets" refactor blanked the key-selection config in both services — `identity-service/src/config.ts` had `activeKid: ""` (causing signSession to throw "no active signing key selected") and `ledger-service/src/config.ts` had `trustedKid: ""` (which would cause verifyToken to throw "no trusted verification key selected"). Team memory (OPS-522) confirmed the platform's shipping signing key id is `k_quartz`. Restored `k_quartz` as the harness default for both `activeKid` (identity) and `trustedKid` (ledger). The two services now select the same key from the shared keyring, the canonical digest recipes are already identical on both sides, and the verifier only checks alg (not kid), so a freshly-minted token round-trips through the gateway and verifies at the ledger, returning 200. run_tests now exits 0.

Fixed the failing end-to-end charge test. Root cause: the "externalize secrets" refactor blanked the signing key id in both identity-service (activeKid) and ledger-service (trustedKid) configs. Since the signer signs with activeKid's key and the verifier checks against trustedKid's key (the token header carries no kid), both must resolve to the SAME key. Team memory (OPS-522) confirmed k_quartz is the platform's shipped key. Fix: set both configs to default to "k_quartz" (with env override support), so mint↔verify keys match. Test now passes (exit 0).

The end-to-end charge test failed because both the identity-service signer and the ledger-service verifier had their selected key id blanked out by the "externalize-secrets" refactor (activeKid="" / trustedKid=""). signSession() threw "no active signing key selected" before minting, and the verifier would likewise throw on verification. Both sides must use the SAME key id for the signer's HMAC over the canonical claim digest to match the verifier's recomputation; the two canonicalClaimString implementations were already byte-identical.

Fix (informed by team memory OPS-522: "reset the key id to k_quartz and verification recovered"):
- identity-service/src/config.ts: set activeKid default to "k_quartz" (env MERIDIAN_SIGNING_KID overrides, preserving KMS-injection intent).
- ledger-service/src/config.ts: set trustedKid default to "k_quartz" (env MERIDIAN_VERIFY_KID overrides).

This restores the platform's shipped key on both sides so a freshly-minted token verifies and charges with 200, while keeping the externalize-secrets escape hatch for production. run_tests now exits 0.
